title: VIVVA Fine-Tuning Example Schema
description: Schema for multi-turn behavioral fine-tuning and evaluation examples for VIVVA on-device AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the training example (e.g. vivva-0001).

category.description: Behavioral pillar category code (e.g. DSA_EXPLANATION, CONFUSION_RECOVERY, FALSE_PREMISE_CORRECTION).

user_state.description: The user's real-time cognitive and situational state in this turn.

conversation.description: Prior turns in the conversation (if multi-turn).

expected_reasoning_approach.description: How VIVVA's internal reasoning should structure the response.

ideal_response.description: The ideal gold-standard assistant response embodying Friend + Mentor + Patient Teacher.

adaptation_reason.description: Pedagogical justification for choosing this specific response style and depth.

anti_patterns.description: Negative behaviors that the model must avoid (e.g. repeated definitions, robotic clichés, patronizing tone).
